newsitem.title: GERMANY: Three women killed in German church bombing.
newsitem.headline: Three women killed in German church bombing.

text.p: Three women were killed and six people were seriously injured in a Christmas Eve bomb attack in a crowded Frankfurt church, German police said on Wednesday.
The powerful bomb completely tore to shreds at least one victim, police said. A 12-year-old child was among the seriously injured.
The attack occurred during a service at a Protestant church in the western Frankfurt district of Sindlingen shortly before midnight and police said there had been no warnings of any kind.
"I have no idea who could have done such a thing on a day like this," Frankfurt police chief Wolfhard Hoffmann told reporters at the scene. "We are completely baffled."
But police said that after preliminary investigations they did not believe the attack was the work of guerrillas.
"We have largely ruled out this being a terrorist attack," said police spokesman Manfred Feist.

There did not appear to be any foreigners in the church or among the casualties. Sindlingen is a working class area of Frankfurt, Germany's financial centre. It is near the giant Hoechst AG chemical plant.

Police said the bomb was placed in a pew near the back of the church, which was crowded with about 70 people attending the Christmas service. Besides the six seriously injured, others were being treated for minor injuries and shock.
"We have no clues about the person responsible (for the attack)," said a police officer. There was also no information on any motive for the bombing, he added.
He said police were searching for a woman who witnesses reported seeing near the church with her face partially covered by a scarf.
The explosion occurred at about 11.15 p.m. (2215 GMT) on Tuesday night.
One of the victims survived the initial blast but died while still in the church as she was being treated by a doctor, police said.
Police quickly sealed off the area around the church and officers in the entire Frankfurt region were put on high alert.
